description: This file is a shell test script for the Git version control system, specifically testing the handling of binary patches via Git apply commands. It sets up a repository, creates various binary diff files, and runs a suite of tests to verify correct behavior when applying, checking, and stat-ing binary patches, including special cases like binary replacements and full-index patches.

methods.name: do_reset
methods.description: Resets the Git workspace to a clean state, removes temporary files, and checks out the main branch.
